families.axis: merely put into words → spelled out to the last unsoftened detail

members.gloss: precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication
members.tone: The neutral benchmark of the family - it claims clarity so complete that nothing is left for the hearer to infer, without praising or faulting that clarity.

members.gloss: precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication
members.tone: Flatter than *explicit*: it records that the thing was actually put into words rather than crediting the wording with precision.

members.gloss: declared as fact; explicitly stated
members.tone: Adds the weight of an announcement standing behind the statement, where *stated* leaves the saying unceremonious.

members.gloss: declared as fact; explicitly stated
members.tone: The plainest way to mark something as asserted in words, carrying none of the formality *declared* brings.

members.gloss: clearly defined or formulated
members.tone: Approving - the formulation is not merely clear but settled, shaped well enough to stand as the version that counts.

members.gloss: clearly defined or formulated
members.tone: Defines by exclusion where *definitive* defines by settlement: the wording is clear because no second reading survives it.

members.gloss: not tacit or implied
members.tone: Formal and pointed, marking a thing as spelled out precisely by contrast with what was left tacit.

members.gloss: describing nudity or sexual activity in graphic detail
members.tone: Carries a faint warning in it - the sexual detail is flagged as unsparing, which the colourless *explicit* does not do.

members.gloss: extremely explicit
members.tone: Blunt and slangy, planting the thing at the far end of the scale where extremity itself is the claim, past *graphic*'s merely detailed.

members.gloss: extremely explicit
members.tone: The closed spelling of *hard-core* with no softening of the force - the same blunt assertion that nothing whatever has been held back.

families.axis: plain attentiveness → exhaustive minute care that tips into excess

members.gloss: exercising caution or showing care or attention
members.tone: The plain baseline of the family - it credits the attention without saying how much of it there is.

members.gloss: providing great detail
members.tone: Informal and concrete - the detail arrives as an unbroken sequence with nothing skipped between one step and the next.

members.gloss: exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
members.tone: Measures the care by its result, enough of it to leave no doubt, where *painstaking* measures the effort instead.

members.gloss: exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
members.tone: Blunter and more offhand than *certain* for exactly the same assurance.

members.gloss: rigorously attentive; strict and thorough
members.tone: Carries a severity the others lack - the attention is strict as well as thorough.

members.gloss: characterized by extreme care and great effort
members.tone: Locates the care in the doer's sense of duty rather than in the finished work.

members.gloss: characterized by extreme care and great effort
members.tone: Puts the labour on show - the pains taken are the point, where *conscientious* keeps them inward.

members.gloss: characterized by extreme care and great effort
members.tone: Adds a moral edge to the same effort - exactness that would balk at the smallest lapse.

members.gloss: developed or executed with care and in minute detail
members.tone: The flat, unshowy member - it credits the fine grain with no suggestion of what producing it cost.

members.gloss: developed or executed with care and in minute detail
members.tone: Suggests worked-up intricacy, care that shows on the surface as complexity.

members.gloss: developed or executed with care and in minute detail
members.tone: Participial and cooler than *elaborate* - it marks a thing as having been worked out rather than admiring the result.

members.gloss: characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination
members.tone: Pitches the attention at the smallest scale available, finer-grained than *detailed*.

members.gloss: characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination
members.tone: Names the tightness of the field under examination rather than the effort spent, so it approves less openly than *minute*.

members.gloss: excessively or unduly careful
members.tone: Turns the family's praise inside out - the care is genuine but has run past the point of use.

members.gloss: excessively or unduly careful
members.tone: Blunter than *overcareful*, with the excess spelled out in plain words rather than folded into a prefix.

members.gloss: providing specific details or circumstances
members.tone: Purely descriptive - it reports that the specifics are supplied and passes no verdict on the care behind them.

families.axis: merely liable to be acted on → overwhelmed by what acted on you

members.gloss: acted upon; influenced
members.tone: The bare fact that something landed, carrying no weight and no direction of its own - every other member here adds force to this.

members.gloss: deeply or markedly affected or influenced
members.tone: Marks the depth of the effect rather than its direction: where *affected* records that something landed, this records that it landed hard.

members.gloss: (used in combination) affected by something overwhelming
members.tone: A combining form for a blow that lands like a spell rather than a hammer - softer in sound than *stricken*, but no less total in what it takes over.

members.gloss: (used in combination) affected by something overwhelming
members.tone: The gravest of the compounding forms, making whatever landed sound like an affliction borne rather than an influence undergone.

members.gloss: (used in combination) affected by something overwhelming
members.tone: The plainest of these compounding forms - the blow and nothing more, where *stricken* adds weight and *smitten* adds enchantment.

members.gloss: infatuated with or enthralled by the theater especially the desire to act
members.tone: Frames a passion for the theater as an infatuation one is caught by rather than a calling one chooses, which leaves it faintly indulgent.

members.gloss: likely to be affected by something
members.tone: Names exposure rather than outcome - nothing has landed yet, the thing merely stands open to it, which sets this apart from every struck-and-overcome member here.

members.gloss: be affected with an indisposition
members.tone: Understated almost to gentleness: the illness simply takes hold, with none of the impact that *struck* or *stricken* put into the same event.

members.gloss: affected by or overcome with wonder
members.tone: The same helpless blow as *struck*, but what lands is wonder, so being overcome reads as elevation rather than damage.

families.axis: bare label of position → rank that carries an air of being better

members.gloss: older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service
members.tone: Bundles age, rank and length of service into one word without choosing among them, so it states standing rather than claiming merit for it.

members.gloss: of the elder of two boys with the same family name
members.tone: A bare distinguishing tag between two boys who share a family name, separating them rather than raising either.

members.gloss: having precedence (especially because of longer service)
members.tone: Formal and procedural, framing seniority as a claim to go first rather than as a quality of the person, where *senior* leaves the entitlement unstated.

members.gloss: having a higher rank
members.tone: Marks the top of an order and leaves the evaluation out, flatter than *superior*.

members.gloss: having a higher rank
members.tone: The one word here whose sense of standing above can be heard as standing better, adding a lift that *higher-ranking* refuses.

members.gloss: having a higher rank
members.tone: Transparent and comparative - it spells out the relation and implies nothing past the position itself.

families.axis: weighty enough to demand attention → threatening great harm with hope nearly gone

members.gloss: being in or verging on a state of crisis or emergency
members.tone: Marks the tipping point rather than the harm itself, the moment at which things break one way or the other, cooler and more clinical than *grave*.

members.gloss: of critical importance and consequence
members.tone: Weight without dread: it asserts that the matter carries enormous importance and consequence, where the threatening members add fear to the weight.

members.gloss: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
members.tone: The plainest of the threatening senses, pointing straight at the harm ahead with none of the solemnity *grave* carries.

members.gloss: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
members.tone: Solemn and hushed, registering the threat as something to be met with gravity rather than merely flagged as *dangerous* does.

members.gloss: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
members.tone: The most formal and heavily weighted of these, sounding the wound itself as much as the threat of it.

members.gloss: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
members.tone: The flattest word here, insisting the threatened harm is real without dramatizing it the way *severe* dramatizes its force.

members.gloss: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
members.tone: Puts the emphasis on the magnitude of the harm threatened rather than on the alarm it produces, harsher than *serious*.

members.gloss: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
members.tone: Literal and clinical, naming outright what stands to be lost where *grave* leaves it implied.

members.gloss: fraught with extreme danger; nearly hopeless
members.tone: Danger with the options gone, adding the collapse of hope that *dangerous* never claims on its own.

members.gloss: fraught with extreme danger; nearly hopeless
members.tone: Portentous and absolute, pronouncing doom over the situation where *desperate* points instead at the straits of those caught in it.

families.axis: bare defensibility → judgment praised as solid, steady and clear-minded

members.gloss: showing reason or sound judgment
members.tone: Mild, floor-setting approval - the judgment clears the bar of sense without being called impressive, where *sound* claims it has no weak point.

members.gloss: showing reason or sound judgment
members.tone: Warmer and more practical than *reasonable*, approving judgment for its plain usefulness rather than its defensibility.

members.gloss: exhibiting native good judgment
members.tone: Blunt, attributive praise for judgment that owes nothing to training - the compliment is the plainness itself, not the cleverness *intelligent* credits.

members.gloss: exhibiting native good judgment
members.tone: The most laboured of the commonsense forms, its stacked suffix making the same praise sound clumsier than the crisp *commonsense*.

members.gloss: exhibiting native good judgment
members.tone: Carries a faintly wry ring, praising the judgment as homely and obvious rather than admirable.

members.gloss: exercising or showing good judgment
members.tone: Casts good judgment as wholesome and robust - a constitution of mind rather than a verdict on one conclusion, warmer and vaguer than *sound*.

members.gloss: exercising or showing good judgment
members.tone: The strongest praise here, crediting the mental power behind the judgment rather than merely certifying that the judgment is good.

members.gloss: exercising or showing good judgment
members.tone: Praises judgment for its steadiness under pressure - coolness when things go wrong, which *reasonable* says nothing about.

members.gloss: exercising or showing good judgment
members.tone: Identical in force to *levelheaded*, the hyphen giving it a slightly more deliberate, spelled-out look.

members.gloss: exercising or showing good judgment
members.tone: Flat, unshowy approval - the judgment has no weak point anywhere in it, structural rather than admiring.

members.gloss: based on sound reasoning or evidence
members.tone: The coolest, most grudging approval in the set - the reasoning can be held against attack, which is less than saying it is right, where *well-founded* asserts the grounds are solid.

members.gloss: based on sound reasoning or evidence
members.tone: Approves the base under a claim rather than the mind behind it, vouching for the evidence where *intelligent* vouches for the thinker.

families.axis: knowledge conceded and then withdrawn → plain schooling → deep, wide-ranging learning

members.gloss: possessing an education (especially having more than average knowledge)
members.tone: The plain baseline of the family, granting the schooling and the better-than-average knowledge that comes with it without the emphasis the others pile on.

members.gloss: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
members.tone: Presents the extensive understanding as something the person actively holds, a state of mind rather than a qualification conferred.

members.gloss: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
members.tone: Praises the sheer stock of information, workaday and unceremonious where *learned* is solemn.

members.gloss: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
members.tone: The weightiest of them, sounding of deep and sustained study and carrying a faint hush of reverence.

members.gloss: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
members.tone: Formal and faintly ornamental, treating the learning as a distinction worn rather than a fund drawn on.

members.gloss: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
members.tone: Puts the weight on the grounding received, crediting the training behind the understanding rather than its range.

members.gloss: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
members.tone: Locates the extensive understanding in books absorbed, claiming breadth of acquaintance where *learned* claims depth.

members.gloss: knowledgeable and educated in one or several fields
members.tone: Sets a competence bar rather than a height, a measured claim of command in a field beside the full sweep of *learned*.

members.gloss: educated by your own efforts rather than by formal instruction
members.tone: Marks how the education was got rather than how much of it there is, substituting one's own effort for instruction.

members.gloss: literate but poorly informed
members.tone: The family's one put-down, conceding the literacy and pulling the substance out from under it in the same breath - the exact negative of *literate*.

families.axis: a pain merely named as keen → a pain rendered as a blade driven through you

members.gloss: keenly and painfully felt; as if caused by a sharp edge or point
members.tone: The bare name for the sensation - an edge felt, with none of the violence *stabbing* adds.

members.gloss: extremely sharp or severe
members.tone: Pitches the same pain at severity itself, clinical and absolute where *sharp* only names the edge.

members.gloss: extremely sharp or severe
members.tone: Measures the pain by sheer magnitude, dropping the blade image that *acute* keeps beside it.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: The pain slices rather than punctures - a drawn edge where *stabbing* is a single thrust.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: Fine-edged and literary, the pain thin and bright rather than the brute violence of *stabbing*.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: Names the blade outright in plain speech, unbookish where *lancinating* is clinical.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: The pain goes through rather than across - penetration where *cutting* draws a line.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: The most brutal of the blade words: pain delivered as a thrust, sudden and driven in.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: Clinical and cold, the technical term for a tearing blade-pain, stripped of the drama *stabbing* carries.

members.gloss: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
members.tone: The participial twin of *lancinate*, same clinical register but with the sensation still running as it is described.

members.gloss: sharp and piercing
members.tone: The most technical of the extremes, stacking sharpness and penetration together where *piercing* names one alone.

members.gloss: (of speech) painful or bitter
members.tone: Turns the edge on speech - words that sting and leave bitterness behind, aimed at a person rather than felt in a nerve.
